Urban Research / Identity — Tura, Meghalaya

What Tura City Needs

Location
Tura, Meghalaya
Category
Urban Research / Identity
Design role
Ola Magdy, Principal Associate Designer
Practice
Archohm

Overview

An urban study of Tura’s growth, public space, mobility and cultural identity. Mapping and observations inform a vision for a walkable town, supported by a family of wayfinding and street elements.
